A [[Gender|female]] individual was the '''daughter''' of [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Lonni Jung]]. Following her birth at some point between [[6 BBY|6]] and [[5 BBY]],<ref name="6BBY" /> her [[Parent|father]] wished to resign from his position in the [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]], where he was secretly a [[spy]] for the curator [[Luthen Rael]]'s [[Axis network|undercover rebel network]]. Jung spoke to Rael about his wish to resign and cited his daughter as one of the reasons why. However, Rael insisted that he not leave, saying he could not ever have the peace he wanted if the [[Galactic Empire]] continued to reign.<ref name="One Way Out" />
